name: revyl
description: Run and verify your app on Revyl cloud devices and browsers from the agent: check setup, start and stop iOS, Android and web sessions, drive the device, and capture screenshots and evidence. Runs Revyl's official CLI MCP server (revyl mcp serve, dev profile) with a Revyl API key from Settings → API Keys. Live device sessions also reach the per-session worker and storage hosts that Revyl's control plane returns, which a run must be granted separately.
